items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: Interviewer mentions Marlon Jordan's CD; Interviewee does not respond with personal connection or knowledge of Marlon Jordan.

ctx.x: That’s great. When you get home, what’s on your CD player?
Now which home are you talking about? No I’m just teasing. Right now in my CD player is Stephanie and Marlon Jordan’s CD, a very good one. Do you have it?
